recognize_zh: 撥開頭髮後，耳朵上方頭皮（紅色箭頭）可見一個小的暗紅色結痂丘疹或糜爛；此類在日光暴露區反覆出現、結痂後留疤的丘疱疹是 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）的臨床表現，但照片本身不具特異性。
features: Clinical photograph of the left temporal scalp above the ear with hair parted by a gloved hand
Small dark red crusted papule or erosion on the scalp (red arrow)
Lesion measures a few millimeters without obvious vesicle or surrounding cellulitis
Small pigmented macule on the helix of the ear, likely incidental
No extensive scarring or alopecia visible at this resolution
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the left temporal scalp, with the hair parted, shows a small dark red crusted papule or erosion just above the ear (red arrow). There is no evident vesiculation, surrounding erythema or scarring alopecia in this view, and a small pigmented macule on the helix appears incidental. The lesion is nonspecific in isolation but is compatible with a crusted papulovesicular lesion in the clinical context of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder. Tissue biopsy with EBER in situ hybridization is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Classic HV is a self-limited childhood photodermatosis without systemic symptoms, whereas HVLPD may have systemic involvement, high EBV DNA load and a clonal EBV-positive infiltrate.
Excoriations and folliculitis show neutrophilic follicular or superficial inflammation without an EBER-positive lymphoid infiltrate.
Herpetic lesions show viral cytopathic change in keratinocytes and are HSV/VZV PCR positive rather than EBER positive.
Bite reactions have eosinophil-rich wedge-shaped infiltrates without EBV-infected lymphocytes.
